catalog_quirks.body: Logfare offers registered accounts unmetered fair-use access with no card, funded by logging every request for research; do not send private data. Only logfare/auto and gemma-4-26b are free-tier routes; glm-5.3, glm-5.3-flash, kimi-k3, kimi-k2.6, qwen-3.8-27b and moondream3.1 return 403 premium. mimo-v2.5 hit an account rate limit twice and is excluded. Usage reports a neurons field. Responses include reasoning content.
catalog_quirks.title: Fair-use free tier funded by logging all traffic
